# Maktab Forex (مکتب فارکس)

> Maktab Forex is a free, bilingual (Dari and English) forex-education community for Afghan
> and Afghan-diaspora traders, founded by Mohammad Akhondzadeh (in the industry since 2012).
> It teaches trading the honest way — education first, with risk management at the centre of
> every lesson — and makes no profit promises. All lessons, tools and content are 100% free
> and delivered through a WhatsApp channel. The site is available in English (root URLs) and
> Farsi/Dari (URLs under /fa/).

## Key facts
- Name: Maktab Forex (Dari: مکتب فارکس). Domain: https://forextradechi.com
- Founder & instructor: Mohammad Akhondzadeh (محمد آخوندزاده) — forex since 2012; BBA, pursuing MBA.
- Audience: Afghan and Afghan-diaspora forex learners; primary teaching language Dari, with English.
- Cost: free. Business model: education community, not course sales; no financial advice, no profit promises.
- Curriculum: Beginner course — 13 lessons (00–12); Advanced course — 21 lessons across 6 modules (F, A, AS, B, C, D). Total 34 lessons.
- Free tools: risk calculator; live economic calendar.
- Distinctive: a neutral, scholarly "Forex in Islam" series (riba, gharar, maysir; Islamic-account checklist) — educational, not a fatwa.

## Core pages (English)
- [Home](https://forextradechi.com/index.html): overview of the free Dari-and-English forex school.
- [Courses](https://forextradechi.com/courses.html): the 13-lesson beginner course and 21-lesson (6-module) advanced course.
- [Islamic Finance](https://forextradechi.com/islamic-finance.html): forex from an Islamic viewpoint; riba/gharar/maysir and an Islamic-account checklist.
- [Tools](https://forextradechi.com/tools.html): free risk calculator and economic calendar.
- [Risk Calculator](https://forextradechi.com/risk-calculator.html): compute position size, amount at risk and risk-to-reward.
- [Economic Calendar](https://forextradechi.com/economic-calendar.html): the week's high-impact economic events.
- [FAQ](https://forextradechi.com/faq.html): is forex halal, is it free, how to start, how much is needed, is it risky.
- [Glossary](https://forextradechi.com/glossary.html): key forex terms (pip, lot, leverage, margin, spread…) in Dari and English.
- [How to Start](https://forextradechi.com/how-to-start.html): a safe step-by-step path for beginners.
- [About](https://forextradechi.com/about.html): mission and founder (Mohammad Akhondzadeh).
- [Join](https://forextradechi.com/join.html): join the free WhatsApp channel.
